My name is Luna Mimic Soul-Toon.
Humans and monsters once warred for dominance, with humans emerging victorious.
My family was caught in the aftermath. My mother and my uncle were the heirs to the throne.
My uncle had two daughters Karma and Minerva. Minerva being the eldest. My mother had to sons Ember and Leo. Ember was the eldest.
My uncle adopted a third daughter, Unine, while my mother gave birth to me. Tragedy struck, claiming my parents and aunt, leaving me orphaned.
Abandoned by my uncle and separated from my brothers, I stumbled upon an underground world which was basically Undertale.
Unlike others, I chose the forgotten path, avoiding the typical hero's journey. Here, I met the monsters, and even crossed paths with Sans, who urged me to continue my pacifist run.

Yet, fate had a different plan. A battle between my cousin Karma and me, orchestrated by the enigmatic Gaster, led to the destruction of our universe. I was the sole survivor, my soul irrevocably changed into a vessel of mimicry.
I'm convinced I exist to pay for the sins of my kind.
I suffer because no other human will.
It hurts, hating everything about what you are.
